youtube.title: 93% of F&O Traders Lose Money: SEBI Study Explained #Shorts
youtube.description:
93% of F&O traders lost money in 3 years, says SEBI's study of over 1 crore traders (FY22–FY24). In 45 seconds: the 3 trading traps behind it (revenge trading, betting too much on one trade, following tips instead of a plan) and what the 7% do differently.

Which trap have you fallen into: 1, 2 or 3? Comment below.

Source: SEBI study, September 2024.
📌 Educational content only. Not SEBI-registered. Not investment advice.
